name: Locanto

sources.title: Homepage (search-indexed) — free local classifieds across US cities; categories Jobs, Vehicles, Real Estate, Buy & Sell, Services, Personals; phone-verified badges
FAQ — 'Post free Ads' button; publication 100% free; listings auto-deactivate after 3 months unless renewed
Ad creation form — requires selecting a city and category; tips: brief title/description, photos, reasonable price

conditions: Posting ads is 100% free, but ads are local classifieds tied to a city — a SaaS product can only be posted as a service/business ad in a chosen city, not as a product listing
Listings auto-deactivate after ~3 months and must be renewed from the account
requirements: Account registration (email) — plus optional phone verification for a trust badge
Pick a city and correct category (Services/Buy & Sell are the closest fit for software)
Ad title, description, photos; reasonable pricing info where applicable
preparation: Account email; phone number if seeking the verified badge
workflow: Register/login at locanto.com (browser — site 403s automated fetches)
Select city and category, enter title/description/photos, publish
Ad goes live within minutes; log in and renew before the ~3-month deactivation
watchFor: This is a local classifieds board — generic SaaS announcements can read as spam; frame as a real service offering in a specific city
Ads expire after ~3 months (email warnings at 1 week and day-of)
Personals/community categories carry scam risk — keep the ad professional
countsAsLive: The ad is publicly visible on the Locanto city category page and reachable via search
unknowns: Whether outbound links/URLs are allowed in ad text and their follow treatment
Whether repeated city postings of the same service get blocked as duplicates
